summary: Cylindrical planetary gear motor with an encoder section at the rear and an 8 mm REX output shaft protruding 80 mm from the gearbox face. Body diameter and body length are not printed in the drawings, so they are estimated.

mountingSurfaces.description: Gearbox output face from which the 8 mm REX shaft extends 80 mm in +z. The bounding box is centered on the part, so the shaft tip is at z=+90 and this face is at about z=+10. The shaft passes through a channel wall, and a hub and wheel are fastened on the far side.

notes: The 80 mm figure in the data is the shaft length, as stated in Product Insight #8 ("80mm shaft length"). It is not the motor body length. The 37 mm body diameter and the roughly 100 mm body length (180 mm overall with the shaft) are estimates, not printed dimensions, so overall z is uncertain. No hole sizes or positions are dimensioned, so the holes list is empty. The drawings do show an M4 screw going into the shaft end, but I did not turn it into a hole entry. The shaft is 8 mm across, with a REX (hex-profile) section.
